summary: Universal Insurance Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into Note Purchase Agreements on June 16, 2026, issuing $100 million of 7.75% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2031 to institutional accredited investors and qualified institutional buyers. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, including redemption of its outstanding 5.625% Senior Notes due 2026. The notes are issued under a private placement exemption and are not convertible or subject to sinking fund. A registration rights agreement provides for an exchange offer. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation.
